scope: Standing Fram Museum on Bygdøynes in Oslo, including the three copper-clad gabled halls and the main public entrance.

originalReview.notes: The waterfront view establishes the large east gable with glazed bands and FRAM lettering, standing copper seams, roof lighting and smaller parallel hall with a glazed gable. Captured before the Gjøa hall opened.

quallaSearch.notes: The three exact Qualla photos were screened first and show the interior. Ida Tolgensbakk’s exact supplemental exterior matches the first signed native CC0 dedication.
